method_metadata.notes: Single-round NPE, same fixed pairs and ConvNeXt encoder as point baseline; trained from scratch. No sbi runtime or original-paper XRD reproduction claim.

interpretation.training_and_external_data_eligibility: Coordinator must audit method_metadata; runner cannot verify training provenance
interpretation.oracle: Uses true labels to select the best candidate; not deployment top-1
interpretation.rank_histograms: SBC interpretation for prior-predictive ID only; OOD/stress ranks are diagnostics (no_signal has exact prior reference)
interpretation.rectangle_coverage: Intersection of marginal intervals; NOT a nominal-alpha joint credible region
interpretation.ci: Structure-cluster bootstrap conditional on trained model; not training-seed uncertainty
interpretation.energy: Normalized prior-width units; unbiased independent-pair sample estimator can be negative by Monte Carlo noise
